Peanut Butter Chocolate Haystacks
By: Michelle La Clair
Published: Saturday, February 20, 2010 - 5:34pm

Ingredients




6 ounces chocolate chips
1/2 cup peanut butter
1 small can chow mein noodle (3 oz.)
2 cups miniature marshmallows

Preparation

1 Melt: 2 Oz. chocolate chips 3 Cup peanut butter. 4 Remove from heat; add: 5 Small can chow mein noodle (3 oz.) 6 Cups miniature marshmallows. 7 Mix well and drop by teaspoonful on wax paper. 8 Chill.
